about_the_game:
The Omega Crafter soundtrack, composed by Eiji Kawai, has arrived!
This collection fully captures and optimizes a diverse range of tracks that bring the game's world to life.

From thrilling melodies that ignite the spirit of adventure as you traverse vast landscapes to nostalgic tunes that recall memories of building towns alongside your Gramies, this soundtrack is filled with sounds that evoke the unique experience of Omega Crafter.

Relive the world of limitless crafting and programming once more—through music!
